text:
IncidentBot: P1 | inference-serving-west1 - 15% 5xx rate, elevated latencies, customer-facing failures. Auto-page sent to #eng-oncall and on-call rotation. Incident channel: #incidents-p1 :rotating_light:

IncidentBot: Actions suggested: runbook 'infserv-p1' recommended, collect logs from pods matching 'infserv-west1-*', add sticky comms owner.

Alex W: I'm on shift for another 8m. I'll take driver for the handoff if nobody objects. I'll stay on bridge until the next primary picks up.

Maria G: thanks Alex. I'm the current primary but need to step out at +10 (meeting). happy to do a quick sync and handoff now.

Jamal R: Alex — quick note: if you take driver, can you also confirm KV cache status? last time cache mismatch caused retries. runbook step 3 mentions `kubectl get pods -l app=infserv -o wide` and `kubectl exec -it <pod> -- /bin/sh -c "tail -n 200 /var/log/infserv/error.log"`.

Alex W: got it. pulling pod list now.

Alex W: ```
# pod check
kubectl get pods -n prod -l region=west1,app=infserv
kubectl exec -n prod infserv-west1-7b9d -- tail -n 200 /var/log/infserv/error.log
```

Alex W: KV cache looks healthy for the majority of pods, one replica shows repeated timeouts to redis cluster. errors look like `ERR_CONN_RESET`. Running rolling restart on the replica to isolate. Will monitor error-rate metric (svc.infserv.errors/5m). :eyes:

Priya S: FYI I'm on APAC overlap, but my window ends in ~20m. can cover infra escalation if it hits region-dependent infra (networking/peering). otherwise limited bandwidth to drive long fixes.

Evan L: I can act as comms owner (external updates + status page) for the next hour. I'll post cadence and take notes.

Maria G: perfect. so current plan: Alex = driver, Evan = comms owner, Maria will shadow and confirm closure before she leaves. Priya backup for infra escalations, Jamal helps with runbook steps and logs.

Alex W: assigned in-channel: Driver: Alex W, Comms: Evan L, Backup infra: Priya S, Runbook owner: Jamal R. I'll also pin the runbook excerpt in #incidents-p1.

Evan L: cadence every 10m for status updates to customers. I'll post 2 short updates now with current impact and mitigation steps.

Evan L: Posting to status page draft — please thumbs up if you approve: 
"We are investigating elevated error rates for inference requests in west1. Mitigations in progress — rolling restart of a subset of replicas and KV cache validation. No customer data exposure identified. Next update 10 minutes."

Maria G: :thumbsup: good. add that we're monitoring latency and will escalate to networking if TCP resets persist.

Jamal R: runbook pointer: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/infserv-p1 — follow sections 2.1 -> 2.4 for quick mitigation. special note: if `svc.infserv.errors/5m` does not drop by 50% after restart, promote to full cluster restart and open infra escalation.

Alex W: restart done for one replica. error-rate dropped from 15% -> 9% on that pod slice. overall svc error -> 11% (still elevated). continuing to roll 1-2 more replicas with 60s delay.

Priya S: if you see `ERR_CONN_REFUSED` instead of `ERR_CONN_RESET`, escalate to network team immediately (peering flaps seen earlier this quarter).

Evan L: first customer update posted. will post next update at +10.

Maria G: thanks team. Alex, if you're still primary after my meeting ends (in 8m), please confirm by dropping a note `Alex W: holding primary` so rotation schedule updates the on-call board.

Alex W: Alex W: holding primary. will continue until relieved.

IncidentBot: Note: On-call rotation metadata updated — current primary set to Alex W, coms owner set to Evan L. Incident severity remains P1.

Evan L: quick checklist I'm tracking: impact summary, mitigation actions, ETA/next update, postmortem owner. tagging @maria-g for postmortem if matter resolves during her shift.

Maria G: unless it fully resolves before my meeting, happy to own postmortem. otherwise pass to Jamal if I'm unavailable.

Alex W: will update when svc.infserv.errors/5m < 3% sustained for 15m.

Evan L: next update in ~8m. thanks all. :raised_hands:
